Reason: The azygos lobe is an anatomical variant located in the right upper pulmonary field, appearing as a teardrop-shaped opacity separated by the azygos fissure. It is classified as Type C when the trigonum parietale (the inferior tip of the fissure) is located medially, close to the trachea or mediastinum, which matches the description in option E.
